This record does not describe a data center. The facility at 1909 East Ray Road in Chandler is tagged as a data center in OpenStreetMap but is actually a legal process-serving company that delivers court documents and subpoenas. The registry does not assert operator, capacity, or specifications for this address.

No IT infrastructure details are available and research into the address has been exhausted without finding a data center operator or facility. The mistagging appears to be a known problem in crowdsourced mapping where generic server tags are applied without verification of actual business function.

This campus should not be treated as relevant to AI infrastructure scaling. It should be disregarded in any assessment of data center capacity, grid demand, or compute availability in Arizona.
